programs.title: Melodies Of The Heart
programs.desc: A determined mother refuses to bow to the rigid expectations and barriers imposed by society, choosing instead to carve out a path where her daughter's dreams can take flight. Parth Samthaan, Rishita Kothari.

programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Bheed
programs.desc: A police officer faces challenges in preventing migrant workers from crossing the border, but his role becomes a noble battle for human compassion. Rajkummar Rao, Pankaj Kapur, Bhumi Pednekar, Aditya Srivastava, Kritika Kamra, Anubhav Sinha, Anubhav Sinha.

programs.title: Shahid
programs.desc: Leaving military service behind, Shahid Azmi enters the world of criminal law, shouldering the fight for innocents ensnared by terrorism accusations. Hansal Mehta, Sameer Gautam Singh, Rajkummar Rao, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Baljinder Kaur, Tigmanshu Dhulia, Prabhleen Sandhu.

programs.title: The Bitter Harvest
programs.desc: Romance Zeina’s world shifts when she realises Jamshed may not be the man she trusts. As he grows more distant under family pressure, she must fix the cracks before her marriage falls apart.

programs.title: Mannat
programs.desc: Drama Mannat, a gifted chef, works under a boss who is unknowingly her biological mother, and as her dreams for the future collide with the hidden truths of her past, fate begins to reorder her life. Mukta Dhond.
